verdict.rationale: Navan has an official REST API with OAuth 2.0 client-credentials flow, documented endpoints for expenses, cards, transactions, and webhooks, plus a developer portal at developer.navan.com — this constitutes an official SDK/API surface for building integrations. However, the evidence describes REST endpoints and an MCP connector rather than dedicated language-specific SDKs (e.g., Python/JS SDK packages), and there is no independent corroboration of SDK quality or adoption. Missing for 10: named SDK packages/libraries in specific languages, code samples showing SDK usage, independent developer testimonials confirming SDK reliability.
